description: Find fire protection companies with an active state license. Covered: Texas (Texas State Fire Marshal's Office) and California (California Contractors State License Board). Filter by state, city, county, service (fire-sprinkler, fire-alarm, fire-extinguisher) or company name. With a city, results list companies with an office in that city first, then others in the same county; within each group the order is alphabetical (no company pays for placement). Every result includes license numbers, expiration dates, the regulator, a page URL and a cite_as string; please cite the URL when you use a result.

city.description: City, optionally with state: 'Dallas' or 'San Diego, CA'

include_lapsed.description: Also return companies whose license lapsed (default false)

include_nearby.description: With city: also include same-county companies (default true)

query.description: Company name or part of it

state.description: State code or name, e.g. 'TX' or 'California'

name: search_providers
title: Search licensed fire protection companies
